lines.text: Many learners say: How much people are here?
Better: How many people are here?
Many! How many students are in your class?

quiz.stem: How ___ students are in your class?

native.tip: Kita bilang “berapa orang”, lalu sering pakai much. Untuk hal yang bisa dihitung, pakai many.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “How much people are here?” 😅 Untuk orang atau benda yang bisa dihitung, pakai many: “How many people are here?” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “many”. Tulis satu pertanyaan How many tentang keluargamu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “berapa orang”, then often use much. For things you can count, use many.
en.caption: Ever say this? “How much people are here?” 😅 For people or things you can count, use many: “How many people are here?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
